version_evidence: Installed build, saved-model header, successful macro compilation and preparation log

parameters.name: foil_target_m
parameters.binding: Automated Mesh / HF_surface / Target Surface Size, relative percentage = target_m / fixed 0.8192 m * 100
parameters.bounds_basis: Baseline 0.0064 m to one dyadic coarsening level 0.0128 m; no finer meshes until resource cost and prism behavior verified. Midpoint in log length. HF_fine volume controls and curvature can mask target changes.

quality_rules.name: invalid_cells
quality_rules.definition: Sum of NegativeVolumeCells, UnclosedCells and DegeneratedFeCells returned by generateMeshReport; may double-count defective cells. Zero requires all checks zero. Missing result prevents acceptance.

notes: Pilot only: fixed prism wall-thickness mode, 15 layers, 0.0001799 m first layer, 0.01546 m total; no prism overrides active. Frozen exposed settings checked before/after; immutable clean-copy hash preserves geometry provenance. Acceptance additionally requires explicit prism and local-resolution reviews. No larger DoE before measured pilot review. Existing 25.19M-cell mesh measured; all new results initially absent.
